Playing Google Widevine test DASH. License: Google UAT test proxy from the Media3 demo. This is not a production license server.
Playing the same Widevine test stream with an explicit DefaultDrmSessionManager and HttpMediaDrmCallback.

ClearKey is supported by Media3 (C.CLEARKEY_UUID), but this sample does not ship keys or a license server. Set drm.clearkey.manifestUri and drm.clearkey.licenseUri in gradle.properties, then rebuild.
